name: focus-compact
description: Gives every compaction, automatic ones included, a standing focus; keeps each summary as a brief on disk; and asks a subagent for a handoff when compaction stops paying (main keeps compacting in place) (/focus-compact).

focus.title: Standing focus
focus.description: What every compaction summary is told to keep. Text typed after /compact is added after it.
focus.default: Focus the summary on: (1) what we are building and why; (2) the restrictions, rules and goals in place, quoting the user's own constraints and decisions exactly rather than paraphrasing; (3) current state: done, partial, not started, with branch names, SHAs and file paths exactly; (4) what we need to build next, in order; (5) traps and dead ends already ruled out. Drop tool output, logs and exploration that no longer matter.

briefDir.title: Brief folder
briefDir.description: Absolute folder (or one under ~/) the compaction briefs are written under, as <briefDir>/<sessionId>/<agent-or-main>-<n>.md. Empty means compact-briefs in Claude's config folder: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/compact-briefs, else ~/.claude/compact-briefs.

keepBriefs.title: Briefs kept per conversation
keepBriefs.description: After each brief is written, only the newest this many of that conversation's briefs are kept. 0 keeps them all.

briefMaxAgeDays.title: Remove briefs older than (days)
briefMaxAgeDays.description: Once per load, at the first recorded compaction, other sessions' briefs older than this are removed, and each folder left empty with them. 0 keeps them all.

showToasts.title: Show toasts
showToasts.description: Toast when compaction stops paying. Display only: counting, briefs and the subagent's handoff note run the same either way.

handoffAfter.title: Hand off after
handoffAfter.description: The number of compactions of one subagent's conversation at which it is asked for a handoff. Main is never asked: it compacts as often as it needs.

minShrinkRatio.title: Poor shrink ratio
minShrinkRatio.description: A compaction that leaves more than this share of the tokens (after / before) asks a subagent for a handoff, and toasts for main.

minTokensForRatio.title: Smallest conversation the ratio judges
minTokensForRatio.description: The poor-shrink rule applies only when the conversation held at least this many tokens before compaction. The count rule is unaffected.
